text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Tulip Sho, a preliminary race for the Classics, is fast approaching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, two Umamusume run into each other at an intersection.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Vodka?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, Scarlet. It's you. Hey.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I guess you're coming to my Tiara tour too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're going to run in the Tulip Sho, aren't you? I just finished registering.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah! You wanted to pick a fight. All I did was take you up on it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are two major paths through the Classics: the Triple Crown and the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their preliminary races aren't completely separate, but the Tulip Sho typically leads to the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Geez… All you had to do is sit back and watch, but you had to jump on in.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You really are a dummy. If you're going to get in my way, just know I won't show you any mercy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're one to talk! You're like a small dog, all yip and no bite.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: At the very least, you could learn how to bark like you mean it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What did you just say?! I hope you enjoy the taste of defeat when I make you eat those words!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll brush you off like you're nothing with my transcendent pacing ability!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Think ya can scare me with fancy words like "transcendent pacing?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two only bumped into each other by chance, but for some reason, they keep on walking together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hate to break it to ya, but that's no match for my edge. Some people call me the "Jackknife."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Don't underestimate the pace of the Classics. If you don't have enough stamina, everyone's just going to trample over you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They start off arguing about racing, but…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You never even clean the room! Your stuff is always all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, what the heck's up with your new pajamas?! Those red squiggles aren't flowers—it's a field of brains, I tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They end up just insulting each other… As roommates, there must be a lot of tension built up between them.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Whatever. On the day of the race, I'll show you that I'm better than you at everything!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: There's no rhyme or reason to the way you run! You're just the number one most annoying opponent that I'm going to beat!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You just keep dreamin' for now, but you're in for a rude awakenin'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This tired back and forth is just too lame. Let's decide things properly, on the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You can't take it back now! I'll see you there!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You better come to the Hanshin Racecourse prepared!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet walks away without a second glance, the wind at her back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though they have different goals, it may be their fate as contemporaries to butt heads.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: S-sorry, Trainer. We were fightin' like little kids back there.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: C-close?! No way! She's nothin' to me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But havin' her flappin' and flutterin' around in the background all the time is a pain.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So let's deal with her real quick before heading to the Derby. It looks like she's up for it too!
